text:
Stefan Erbe to Premiere “Metamorphosys” – A Multimedia Exploration of AI at Max Reger Music School
A captivating fusion of electronic music and visual art is set to unfold at the Max Reger Music School in Hagen, Germany, as Stefan Erbe prepares to launch his new album, “Metamorphosys.” The performance, scheduled for Saturday, October 11th, 2025, at 7 p.m., promises an immersive experience delving into the burgeoning world of AI-generated worlds.
A Journey into the Future of Sound and Vision
The concert will take place in the concert hall of the Max Reger Music School, located at Dödterstraße 10. Erbe’s work is characterized by a seamless integration of auditory and visual elements, creating what one observer described as a “total work of art.” “Metamorphosys” specifically explores the implications and aesthetics of artificial intelligence, presenting a sonic landscape inspired by AI-created environments.
The performance isn’t simply a concert; it’s a multimedia event. Erbe produced both the soundtrack and the accompanying film, which will be projected live alongside the music. This large-scale projection will enhance the immersive quality of the experience, enveloping the audience in the album’s thematic universe.
Details for Attendees
Tickets for the event are available for 12 euros. The Max Reger Music School has long been a hub for musical innovation in Hagen, and this event continues that tradition by showcasing cutting-edge electronic music. The event was initially announced on Wednesday, October 8th, 2025, building anticipation for the premiere.
This performance represents a significant moment for both Erbe and the Max Reger Music School, solidifying their commitment to pushing the boundaries of artistic expression. The exploration of AI as a creative force positions “Metamorphosys” as a timely and thought-provoking work, inviting audiences to contemplate the future of art and technology.
